items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee is identified as J.C. Higginbotham. The interviewer mentions Tricky Simons in the context of Sidney Bechet's band ('King Them Bells' records). The interviewee does not respond to this specific mention or provide any personal anecdote connecting himself to Tricky Simons.

ctx.x: Yeah, cause they're the only two trombones that I remember. Of course, Tricky Simons (2) didn't really feature him. He and Sonny Greer, they'd with "King Them Bells" records like that.
When did you start coming in contact with Sidney Bechet? Moshey (?)?
